Commentary.Commentary: That is all for this game. Another easy win for India. All things are pointing towards an India-Pakistan final, assuming Pakistan will beat Bangladesh on Wednesday. But, what if - Afghanistan beat Bangladesh in Abu Dhabi tonight, then beat India on Tuesday and Bangladesh beat Pakistan? You never know. Please do keep an eye on the Afghanistan-Bangladesh contest. We shall be back on Tuesday, September, 25, 2018 at 1530 local (1130 GMT) when Afghanistan meet India in Dubai. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

SHIKHAR DHAWAN HAS BEEN NAMED THE MAN OF THE MATCH. Very cool is he, in receiving the award. Says that he enjoyed the innings. On his second century in the tournament, Shikhar says that Pakistan have a good bowling attack but the track is very good for batting. Stresses that he did not want to throw his wicket away and wanted to bat sensibly. Adds that he has learnt his lesson the hard way. Further says that once you play 20 overs, it becomes easier to bat. Also says that it is the job of the openers to see off the new balls and set the game up for the rest of the batsmen. Admires the way Rohit plays and his conversion rate from 50s to 100s and says he is learning from him. Hopes that the two of them continue to do well for the team.

India's captain, Rohit Sharma, says that these are challenging conditions out there and credits his players for showing character. Adds that every match is important and they take every game as a fresh assignment by forgetting what has happened in the past. Lauds his bowlers, especially Bumrah, who Rohit feels has matured as a bowler. Stresses that the fast bowler understands his game better and knows what field to set and how to keep it tight. Credits his pacers for building pressure and then has a word of praise for his spinners as well. On variety in India's spin attack, Rohit replies that they have played some great amount of cricket. After Hardik got injured, it was a challenge to play four spinners (smiles while counting Kedar Jadhav) as he suggests it was a big headache to get their combination right. Again, credits his entire bowling attack for sticking to the task. On Dhawan's batting and his partnership with him, Rohit smiles and says that they know each other well and it's important to let Dhawan play the way he is doing right now. Adds they understand each other's game and their plan always is to not lose early wickets which more often than not puts them in the driving seat. Hopes to keep going as long as possible. When asked about his batting, Rohit once again smiles and says that he has worked hard on that aspect and he backs his ability. To understand the importance of the new balls is the key, Rohit opines.

Pakistan's captain, Sarfraz Ahmed, is disappointed and says that it was a tough game although they put a good score on the board. But rues the dropped catches which didn't help their cause. On being asked about why catches are not being held, he replies that his boys are working hard but has no idea why it's not reflecting in the field. Feels that had they taken the catches, it was a tough wicket for the new batsman coming in. Adds that the pitch had cracks and it wasn't easy for batting and early wickets were needed. Again emphasizes on their shoddy fielding. Mentions that he has been talking with his bowlers for providing early wickets as that's the key if they want to compete and win at this level. Praises Rohit and Dhawan for the way they batted and admits that they need to improve their skill level which is not up to the level of the Indians. Hopes to do well against Bangladesh, which can become a do-or-die match.

What is it about Pakistan? Started brilliantly against Hong Kong, then slumped against India, scraped through against Afghanistan and tonight again, stuttered. Tonight, they did well to spend time in the middle and even though they lost badly, one will reckon that they did put up a challenging total on board. But their fielding let them down big time. 238 would have become a different proposition had Rohit's catch been taken by Imam early. Pakistan will now be hoping to win their final fixture against Bangladesh on Wednesday and qualify for the final. Please stay tuned for the presentation...

As far as Dhawan is concerned, well, he has become the king in ODIs. Very seldom does he fail with the ball not doing much and today he added another century to his kitty. He has been in excellent shape throughout the tournament and will be hoping to end this final week in Dubai in the same fashion.

Everything was not totally rosy though. Dhawan was fluent but Rohit struggled in his initial phase. He survived a dropped chance but then made that count. Once he got to his 50, he assumed a different role altogether. Consider this - he reached his 50 on his 65th ball and in the next 54 balls, he clobbered 61. Overall, it may not be a massive difference but the one who saw the game will understand the progression.

Easy-peasy. India have made a mockery of the run chase. Sorry. Dhawan and Rohit have crumpled Pakistan. Their 210-run stand literally did not allow the Men In Green to even think about the win. 10TH SUCCESSIVE WIN FOR INDIA IN ASIA CUPS (ODIS AND T20IS COMBINED).

INDIA WIN BY 9 WICKETS! Their first ever in ODIs against Pakistan. Full and outside off, Rayudu looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards cover. He is halfway down the track but Rohit is looking back to check where the ball is. Still, Rayudu goes for the run but the fielder shows lack of game awareness. Instead of going to Rohit's end, he goes at the bowler's end and misses the stumps.
Squares him up. Tossed up on off, Rayudu looks to defend but the ball spins away, takes the outside edge and goes to short third man.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Full on middle, driven back to the bowler.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total. The scores are level.
A short ball outside off, Rohit miscues his pull towards mid on.
Yorker outside off, Rohit digs it out to the off side.
Full and outside off, driven through cover for a single. 3 more to win.
A short ball, outside off, pulled through mid-wicket for a couple. 4 needed...
Just 6 needed. Will India finish this with a biggie?
Full and outside off, Rayudu sweeps it through square leg for one.
On middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On middle, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
SIX! CRASH! A short ball outside off, Rohit climbs onto it and heaves it massively over mid-wicket! The long hops keep on coming and the balls keep on disappearing.
Another long hop, helped down to fine leg for a run.
A short ball, pulled to mid-wicket for a single.
Full and straight, watchfully defended.
On middle and leg, flicked away but straight to short mid-wicket.
The batsman has driven that ball straight back.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
On middle, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.

CENTURY NUMBER 19 IN ODIS! Both openers have got to their milestones and India are simply cantering to a win now. On middle, Rohit works it through mid-wicket and comes back for an easy couple. Well played, skipper. Now, to stay unbeaten in the chase.
Full and outside off, watchfully blocked out.
FOUR! Cheeky. On a length, outside off, Rayudu waits for the ball to come to him and dabs it to third man for a boundary.
On the pads, another easy flick for a run. Pakistan are looking so deflated that in spite of a new man in the middle and someone reaching a milestone, the field is simply not up.
Short and outside off, cut away for a run.
Full on middle, driven towards mid on.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
On middle and leg, eased through square leg for a single.
Hasan Ali is rewarded for that run out. 6-0-33-0 so far.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full and outside off, pushed towards long off for a single.
Birthday Ambati Rayudu who has turned 33 today, walks in at number 3, replacing Dhawan. Nothing much he can do as far as the game is concerned.

OUT! No 10-wicket win for India. Dhawan is run out. In fact, even though it was referred upstairs, Dhawan was walking back to the pavilion. A rare communication failure between the openers. Rohit dabs it towards point and Dhawan, without any warning, rushes for the single. The Indian skipper is not the least bit interested and Dhawan has to turn back. Hasan Ali quickly gets to the ball from cover and returns the ball to Malik who disturbs the bails. He does not even appeal to the umpire, rather, signals to him that it is out. They do the mandatory check for the third umpire and replays confirm that Dhawan is short by a yard. End of a stunning 210-run stand, the highest ever opening wicket partnership for India in ODI run chases.
Howzzat? Have India been robbed off a 10-wicket win?  Dhawan is the man in question. Referred upstairs.
Outside off,punched towards cover for a run.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single. Moves to 95. No hurry to get to that century.
FOUR! Fine way to end the over. 15 from it! Full and outside off, Dhawan hammers this through mid off and gets a boundary!
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
SIX! CRACK! Toying with the bowling now. A short ball, outside off, Dhawan pulls this into oblivion, wayyyy over mid-wicket!!!
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.

FOUR! CENTURY NUMBER 15 IN ODIS! That too, in just 95 balls. With 15 fours and 1 six. Who remembers England now? At least, not Dhawan. He has been in tremendous form in this tournament. Full and outside off, Dhawan just eases this past extra cover and mid off has no chance running to his right. He celebrates as usual by taking his helmet off and then hugs his skipper. Well played. Now, for a quick finish? Errr... sorry. Quicker finish?
7000 ODI RUNS FOR ROHIT SHARMA! Third fastest Indian to reach that mark and 5th fastest overall. Gets there with a simple dab to third man for a single.
Sly DJ. He is playing the song, 'MAIN HOON SUPERMAN'. That is going nicely for Dhawan and Rohit at the moment. From where can Pakistan find their superman?
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Full on middle, watchfully defended to the off side this time.
Around leg, defended to the leg side.
99... outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
Ooohh... full and around middle, Dhawan looks to defend but the ball spins away, takes the outside edge and goes towards short third man. First slip might have gobbled it.
On middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Shoaib Malik has been introduced now.
FOUR! What a shot! A short ball outside off, Dhawan jumps and then upper cuts it over point for a boundary! Moves to 98!!!
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
On a length outside off, Sharma waits for the ball to come to him and dabs it to third man for a single.
FOUR! Bad bowling. Short and down the leg side, Rohit swivels and pulls it behind square leg for a boundary! Moves to 90 from 93 balls with his 7th four.
Down the leg side, Rohit looks to pull but the ball runs off the inside edge towards fine leg. A couple taken.
On length, around middle and off, defended to the leg side.
Sarfraz goes to pace again. Really now, it is more or less moral for the fielding unit. Just 59 runs needed. Can they pick up a wicket or two? 4-0-16-0 for Shaheen so far.
Outside off, punched down to long on for a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot for a single.
On middle and leg, watchfully defended.

FOUR! The googly, and punished. Short and outside off, Dhawan plays it with the angle and punches it through the covers for a boundary. Moves to 93. Both batsmen are in a race to get to century first.
Full on middle, pushed towards long on for a run.
On middle, pushed wide of mid on for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed through mid off for a run.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. They pick up a single.
Down the leg side, helped fine for a run.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Dhawan punches this on the up through the covers and finds the gap.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

DROPPED! Things going from bad to worse for Pakistan now. Rohit bludgeons this pull towards short mid-wicket where Fakhar Zaman is just not able to hang on to that sharp chance. Doubt whether it would have mattered but still... Shadab is on his knees.
SIX! THERE COMES NUMBER 300!!! His sixes in international cricket, that is. Another short ball, Rohit rocks back and heaves it over mid-wicket!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Comes down the track and drives it towards long off for a single.
Outside off, punched towards cover.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Stays back in his crease and blocks.

FOUR! He is in his own zone now. He struggled to get to his 50 but since then, the Indian skipper seems to have exploded. Full and outside off, this is swept with disdain behind square leg. No man in the deep over there.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and outside off, Dhawan comes down the track and on seeing that, the bowler throws it wide. The ball hits the toe end of the bat and rolls towards long off. A single taken.
Mohammad Nawaz is on as well. 5-0-23-0 so far.
FOUR! What a delightful shot. Outside off, Rohit leans and drives it through the covers for a boundary! 150 UP FOR INDIA! 14 from the over.
Full and outside off again, this is watchfully defended.

Full and outside off, Sharma tries to reach out for that as he attempts to sweep and gets a top edge. Luckily for him, it lands in not man's land around square leg and the batsmen return for the second.
Outside off, Rohit tries to run it down to third man but misses.
SIX! CLOUT! A short ball outside off, Rohit rocks back and pulls it massively over mid-wicket! Six number 299 in international cricket for him.

Down the leg side, Rohit flicks it away through mid-wicket. The man at short mid-wicket, Fakhar Zaman, gets to the ball quickly with a full-length dive and then does a quick release towards the bowler's end but it is very wide. Hence the fielder backing up cannot even reach it. The second is taken. Sarfraz is actually short of words now.
Shadab Khan into the attack again. 5-0-25-0 so far.
FOUR! No mistake with the pull shot this time. It is banged in short and Dhawan pulls it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
The batsman drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
A short ball, for once, Dhawan mistimes his pull. It lobs through the vacant mid-wicket region. Just a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full and outside off, eased through the covers for a single.
Around off, watchfully defended.

SIX! CLUNK! Fine shot. Like the other night, Pakistan bowlers are not learning to bowl against Dhawan. He feasts on short stuff. And his stomach has got plenty of capacity. Never gets tired of long hops. Swivels and sends this over square leg. Almost a flat hit. 11 from the over, 107 more needed to win from 156 balls.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side. They manage to come back for the second.
Stays back in his crease and blocks.
Outside off, worked towards short mid-wicket.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Oh... excellent running. Excellent awareness. Rohit dabs this towards point and sets off for a quick single. The fielder from backward point gets across to his right and puts in a slide, trying to field the ball. But in reality, he doesn't. Dhawan does not know this, so he puts his hand up for Rohit to stop. But the Indian captain has seen what the fielder has done and can clearly see where the fielder in the deep is. By the time the latter can get to the ball, Rohit is ready to shake hands with his partner. Dhawan is shell-shocked to see Rohit by his side but then he promptly agrees to run. The throw comes in at the bowler's end, misses the stumps but the southpaw would have been in.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
A slower ball this time, once again SD is beaten on the outside edge in his attempt to push the ball towards third man.
Some chin music for the batsman, he lets that bouncer through to the wicket-keeper.
Good bowling. Hasan lands this on a length outside off, Shikhar looks to play it towards third man but the ball straightens a touch and beats the outside edge. The bowler has his hands on his head.
A short ball outside off, Dhawan lets it sail over his head.

Oohhh.... another piece of luck for Rohit. On a length outside off, the Indian skipper looks to punch it on the up but the ball comes back in a long way and goes off the inside edge towards fine leg. A single taken.
Angling away from the batsman, Rohit reaches out for it and punches it to sweeper cover for a single. 9 from Amir's over, 30 in his 4. Really struggling for form.

Fifty up for Rohit Sharma, his 37th in ODIs! He continues with his good form. If you remember, he was dropped on 14 by Imam and Pakistan have only themselves to blame. A length ball around leg, Sharma glances it off his hips to deep backward square leg for a couple of runs. Not a free-flowing knock like Dhawan but he has played his part in this unbeaten century stand.
Goes full now, on middle, Dhawan nudges it through mid on for a single.
Bumper! A typical fast bowler's response. Amir bangs it in, nicely-directed, Dhawan picks it early and this time sways away from the line.

FOUR! Sarfraz is clearly frustrated as he uses his cap to wipe off his sweat on the forehead. Amir drags his length back and bowls it around off. Dhawan loves it there. Rocks back and pulls it powerfully to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Too full and outside off, Rohit squeezes it out to third man and takes a single. Nelson is the score.
Third spell for Mohammad Amir.
A touch short and around off, Rohit dabs it down to third man and jogs to the other end.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads.
An ugly hoick attempted by Rohit but he fails to make any connection. Full and wide outside off, Rohit swings and misses.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Shortish and outside off, cut off the back foot but straight to point.
Nice shot. Strides forward to a length ball and drives it through covers for a couple of runs.
A googly around middle and leg, Dhawan hops back to hit it towards cover-point where Hasan Ali makes the stop and throws it a bit waywardly to Sarfraz.
Fullish and on middle, it's driven down through mid on for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Boom! Loopy and on middle, Dhawan runs down the track to meet the pitch of the ball and drills it straight down the ground for a boundary.
A low full toss on middle, it's forced down to long on for a run.

13th 100-run partnership comes up between the pair! Tossed up ball on off, it's been worked away through mid-wicket for a run. These two are building their own legacy, only behind the legendary pair of Tendulkar and Ganguly in the list of most opening century partnerships for India.
Short in length and outside off, Dhawan flashes his bat through the line and runs it down to third man for a run.
The line is too straight this time and Sharma eases it through mid-wicket for a run.
Movement back into the batsman, Rohit tries to keep it out but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The bowler gets excited for a second but then he realizes there is some wood involved.
Angles in a length ball on middle and off, Dhawan turns it in the gap at square leg for one.

FOUR! Nails his pull shot. Fetches a short ball from outside off, keeps his weight on the back foot and hammer-pulls it through mid-wicket. No fielder in the deep and it's a boundary. Ali needs to rethink his line and length if he wants to bowl from 'round the wicket with no fielder in the deep on the leg side.
Shortish and on off, punched off the back foot to deep cover for a run.
Hasan Ali is brought back into the attack.

Drinks break. A strong going by India in this run chase. Both their openers are looking in fine touch and Rohit after the dropped catch has started to bat quite watchfully. Dhawan, on the other hand, has been free-flowing and will be eyeing a big one tonight. 147 more needed and Pakistan will have to find a wicket somehow to stay in the hunt.

FOUR! Good effort but in vain. Loopy and around leg, spinning down, Dhawan plays a full-blooded sweep shot down to deep backward square leg where Afridi rushes across to his left and puts in a full length dive to pull it back. The umpire goes upstairs to check and the replays find that although Afridi pulled it back but then it brushed his right hand when his body was in contact with the rope. A boundary is signalled. 26th ODI fifty for Shikhar Dhawan. Effortless, so far.
Four? It seems that Shaheen Afridi has made a good stop near the rope. But the umpire wants it to be checked...
Goes with the spin and strokes it through covers for a single.
Spinning away from the batsman outside off, Rohit takes a stride forward and then leaves it alone.
Tossed up ball on middle, Rohit paddles it towards short fine leg and looks for a run. Seeing Amir make a diving stop, Dhawan hesitates and eventually they don't go for it.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.

Sarfraz is really unhappy with Nawaz. After the end of the last over, he was seeing having a very animated discussion with him. Needs to calm down a bit. That was the first over where he erred a bit, otherwise has bowled quite decently.
Floated full ball on off, Dhawan lunges and defends it to mid-wicket.

FOUR! A boundary to start the over and a boundary to end it. Nawaz serves a long hop outside off, Rohit goes deep inside the crease, doesn't try to hit it too hard and just concentrates on the placement. Finds it with finesse and it races through point for a boundary.
Flatter and a touch shorter around off, Rohit plays at it late by opening the face of the bat but finds the short third man fielder.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Uses his feet to come down the track and brings his bat and pad together in defense.
Fires in a quicker one around off, Rohit lunches and pushes it in the gap at covers for a run.
FOUR! First one conceded by a spinner. Good start to the over! Tossed up ball landing outside leg, Rohit kneels down and sweeps it superbly behind square leg for a boundary.

Flighted and outside off, driven with the spin to sweeper cover for one. The spinners so far have given 24 runs in the combined 7 overs bowled. They are putting a lid on the scoring rate but Pakistan need wickets from them.
A bit on the shorter side, on middle, Rohit goes back and punches it to mid-wicket.
Once again clips it with the spin to the leg side and this time finds the gap through backward square leg. A single taken.
Bowls it full and on middle, it's worked towards square leg.
Slower one this time, a lot of flight on this googly around off. Rohit goes back and plays it down towards the cover region for a single.
Flatter and on off, Rohit gets on the front foot in defense.
Tossed up ball on off, turning back in, Dhawan gets on the front foot and defends it off the inner half of his bat to the leg side.
Fullish and on leg, knocked down to long on for one.

Leans forward and pushes it with gentle hands to covers. They scamper across for a quick single and Sarfraz is not happy with his fielder inside the ring. Rightly so, he is there to stop singles but is very slow in anticipating the ball.
Fuller and on off, Rohit gets forward and drives it through mid off for a run.
Sarfraz gets in a slip after the last ball. Full and flighted on off, defended off the front foot.
Slows this up in the air and gets it to spin away from the batsman. Around middle, Rohit tries playing inside the line and gets an outside edge wide of short third man. Two taken.
A touch short around middle and spinning back in, Dhawan works it off his pads but fails to beat the diving short fine leg fielder.
Bowls with a slip in place now. Although he slips in a googly around off. Too full in length around off and Rohit steps down the track and pushes it through mid on for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side through mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Slightly quicker and fuller on leg, Dhawan tries to flick but misses. It goes off his pads to square leg.
A little bit of away spin for Shadab and Rohit plays it down wide of short third man for a run.

Full and on off, Dhawan once again flicks it on the leg side but finds mid-wicket this time. Good tidy over by Nawaz, two coming off it. 11 in the last three overs. Pakistan trying to dry-up the flow of runs.
Floated and on middle, Dhawan works it off his pads but finds the fielder standing in front of square leg.
Finds the gap on this occasion. The length once again is too full and outside off, Rohit plays the off drive, finds the gap through mid off and crosses.
Too full and on off, Rohit drives it through the line but straight back towards the bowler this time.
Tossed up ball on off, pushed with the spin to the off side but straight to covers.

Sharp single! Loopy and full around off, Dhawan strides forward and pushes it gently to the right side of the cover fielder. He attacks the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. A single completed rather easily.
Shadab drops it short around middle and Dhawan pulls it powerfully through mid-wicket for a single. 5 coming off the leggie's first over.
Turning away from the southpaw, Dhawan rocks back and punches it to sweeper cover for a couple.
Tossed up ball on off, spinning back in just a shade, Dhawan deals with it from the back foot and pushes it on the leg side. Not in the gap though.
Possibly a googly, landing on middle, Rohit gets back and works it off his pads through square leg for a single.
Flighted on middle, forced down to long on for a run.
Beaten! Flatter and shorter on off, skidding away, Dhawan tries to cut it off his back foot but misses.
Shadab Khan comes into the attack after an 8-run over by Amir. So just one-over spell for the pacer.
Slows this up in the air and serves it around middle, there is some turn after it lands but Rohit does well to account for it and defends it to the off side.
Fires it flat and full on middle and leg, Dhawan knocks it down to long on to rotate the strike.
Loopy and full around off, Rohit drives it to the left of the cover fielder and crosses.
A bit short and on off, Rohit plays it from the crease to covers.
Full and flighted on off, Dhawan quietly pushes it on the off side, wide of the point fielder, and steals a single.
Shortish and on off, Rohit stands back and hits it firmly down to long on for a run. With a maximum of four fielders now allowed outside the ring, you can get plenty of gaps in the field.

FOUR! Magnificent shot once again! 50 up for India. Dhawan is looking in sublime touch. Another shot down the ground, this time there is a little bit of power as well along with some timing. A delivery around off, Dhawan has put it away in style, no chance for mid on yet again. Two boundaries off this over. Powerplay 1 done and dusted and India are off to a fine start.
A length ball on off, Dhawan blocks it off his back foot.
Dhawan has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! Outstanding timing! Amir angles in a length ball around off, Dhawan gets forward just a bit and offers the full face of the bat. It finds the middle and races away down the ground, past the right side of the mid on fielder, for a boundary.
On a good length outside off, Dhawan this time plays from the crease to point.
Starts this spell with a length ball on off, Dhawan defends it to the off side.
Mohammad Amir is back on. Change of ends for him.
Flatter and on off, defended off the back foot. A decent first over by Nawaz.

Superb fielding, Shaheen! Saves three runs for his side. A sweep shot by Dhawan speeds towards short fine leg where Afridi puts in a full length dive to his left to stop it with one hand. They cross for a single and almost all the Pakistan fielders are going to pat him on the back.
Darts his length short around off, Dhawan cuts it off his back foot to point.
Another delivery on the pads of Dhawan, who fails to make any use of it.
Wide! Too leg sidish this time, Dhawan tries his best to put it away but misses.
Full floated ball on off, Dhawan is on the front foot and once again flicks it to mid-wicket. Sarfraz is impressed with the line and shouting 'shaabaash' 'shaabaash'.
Tossed up ball on middle, Dhawan works it on the leg side but finds mid-wicket.
First look at spin! Mohammad Nawaz to roll his arm now. He was successful in the last game and never let Pakistan miss Shadab Khan.
Shortish on off, jumping a bit onto the batsman, Rohit goes on his toes to play it down. It rolls behind to the keeper.
Bowls it on a length and on the middle and off stump line, Rohit shows the full face of the bat in defense.

FOUR! No stopping this one! Shaheen pitches it up wide outside off, plenty of width on offer and Rohit just goes through with his shot. Inside-out over covers and there is no one in the deep. He plays these shots so effortlessly.
A little bit of width on offer outside off, Dhawan stands back and runs it down to third man for a run.
The batsman has played it to the point region. No run.
Length ball shaping back into the batsman from around off, Shikhar blocks it off his back foot.
Covers the line of the delivery, Rohit defends it off his back foot.
Angling away from the batsman, on a good length, Sharma punches from the back foot but straight towards covers.
Another mistimed shot. Dhawan closes the face of the bat early as he tries to flick. Fails to put bat on ball and it rolls on the off side. They cross and it's given as a run. Maybe, some wood.

EDGY FOUR! Not going Pakistan's way! Dhawan goes hard at a full delivery outside off and edges it behind. Third man this time is standing square as a result of the first boundary and this time it scoots to his right to meet the fence.
Good length ball on off, defended off the back foot.

FOUR! Excellently done. Just uses the pace of the bowler. Shortish delivery outside off, Dhawan just reaches out for it and places his shot behind point for a boundary. Third man is quite straight and he has got no chance of cutting it off.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot. End of the over where Pakistan should have a wicket.
A low full toss on middle, pushed back towards the bowler.

DROPPED BY IMAM! Well, well, well... What have you done? A sitter really and it has gone in and out of his hands in no time. And once again, it is Shaheen Afridi at the receiving end. He does so well to deceive the batsman with a change in pace. Rohit is foxed as he checks his drive at the last moment. It goes straight to Imam-ul-Haq at short cover who fails to hold on to it. He probably thought it's coming too quickly to him. Leaps a bit which wasn't needed actually. Early life to Rohit and we all know how costly  it can prove to be.
That's a much better line. Keeps it around off on a length and Rohit defends it to the off side.

SIX! All timing, zero power. Shaheen is on the shorter side around leg, Rohit turns inside the crease with his pull shot and sends it packing ten rows back over backward square leg. The crowd certainly enjoyed it.
A length ball in line of the stumps, Rohit stands back and plays it off his pads to mid-wicket.
Shortish and angling away from the batsman, Dhawan plays a back foot punch but finds the fielder on the off side.
Width on offer outside off, Rohit slashes it towards cover-point where the fielder gets across to his left to stop the ball. Good enough time for a single.
Angling into the batsman, not much room to play with, Rohit keeps it out off his pads to mid-wicket. The bowler himself collects it to his right.
Goes on the back foot and plays it down safely on the off side.

FOUR! First boundary for Rohit. Not only square of the wicket on the off side, Sharma loves it on the leg side as well. Hasan drops it short and on middle, Ro puts it away with a little swivel inside the crease. Gets on top of the bounce and stylishly sends it to the deep backward square leg fence.
Starts with a length delivery outside off, Sharma patiently leaves it alone.
Hasan Ali is into the attack after just two overs by Mohammad Amir. Rohit will be on strike, first time after the second over.
A length delivery outside off, Dhawan inside edges his attempted cover drive back towards the bowler. Just a boundary off the over, a good one again by Shaheen.

Imam saves a certain boundary! Fantastic fielding effort. Dhawan plays a crunching cover drive but fails to pierce the gap. Sarfraz seems unhappy with the length Shaheen is bowling. Maybe, he wants the tall pacer to bang it in short.
Good length delivery on off, Dhawan plays it down with soft hands to point.

A mishit this time. Length ball outside off, Dhawan goes hard at it and gets it away off the inside edge. It rolls in front of square leg and he comes out of the crease in search of a run. Rohit sends him back.

FOUR! Lovely timing this time! A delivery angling into the batsman, anything in line of the stumps and Dhawan is quite severe. He just picks it up and flicks it with beautiful timing through mid-wicket. No chance this time for the fielder running after it.
Back of a length delivery on off, moving back in a bit, Dhawan stays back footed in defense.
Drags his length short and bowls it outside off, Dhawan goes back and cuts it firmly down towards third man for a run. 7 from the over.

FOUR! What a shot, first boundary of the Indian innings! Not a bad delivery but it's played quite nicely. A length delivery landing outside off and shaping back in off the seam, Dhawan strides forward and strokes it elegantly through covers.
Mid-wicket drops back. Going more towards deep square leg.
Amir overpitches this time, around off, Dhawan pushes it down the ground but finds Malik at mid on.
Good length ball on off, Dhawan presents a straight bat as he blocks it out solidly to covers.
Full and on middle, angling into the batsman, Dhawan leans forward and flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Fractionally short in length and on off, Dhawan remains on the back foot and keeps it out towards cover-point.

Good length ball on middle and off, Rohit covers the line and blocks it to the off side. Impressive first over by Shaheen, showed no signs of nerves. Playing against arch-rivals is a lot of pressure for a player, especially for a young boy.
Mixing his lengths quite nicely, Shaheen. Hits the yorker mark outside off, Rohit squeezes it out to point.
Sharma has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Excellent delivery. Afridi pulls his length back a shade. Serves it around off and gets it to move across the batsman. Rohit remains back footed as he pushes inside the line and misses.
A lovely yorker, around off, Rohit falls a bit across as he tries to dig it out towards mid-wicket.
Some visible swing in the air first up. Too full and wide outside off, Dhawan chases it and drives it in the gap at cover-point for a single.
Shaheen Afridi to operate with the second new ball from the other end. He had a good ODI debut, although was a bit unlucky with a few catches going down off his bowling.

IN THE AIR... just short of backward point. Back of a length ball around off, leaving the batsman, Rohit smashes it through the line but fails to keep it down. It flies towards Shadab who goes down low but it falls just in front. Amir has a smile on his face. He knows that he nearly got Rohit there. Good start by him.

Wrong line first up to the southpaw. Continues bowling the same line that he was bowling to Rohit. It turns out to be on middle and leg for Dhawan, who just nudges it through mid-wicket and gets off the mark with three runs.
Angling across the batsman, Rohit plays inside the line and taps it to the left side of the backward point fielder. A single taken.
This time it straightens a touch after landing on a length around middle, Rohit offers a straight bat in defense.

Shot! Just loves it there. Back of a length delivery around off, angling away from the batsman, Rohit cracks it square of the wicket on the off side and it races wide of backward point. Shaheen Afridi runs across to his right from third man to stop the ball. A couple of runs taken, India are underway.
Starts well. It's on a fuller length around off, not much swing, Rohit is on the front foot as he defends it back to the bowler.

Time for the run chase! The Men in Green are in a huddle currently with Sarfraz Ahmed sharing some last minute inspirational words with his boys. Out come the Indian openers now. It's the same reliable pair of Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan. Needless to say, start will be very crucial. Rohit on strike. Mohammad Amir, who was dropped/rested in the last game, to begin with the first new ball. A slip in place. Here we go...
